description: This is a test class for the HelpConfigService in the OrangeHRM HRM system. It sets up the test environment, loads configuration fixtures, and tests the methods getHelpProcessorClass() and getBaseHelpUrl() of the HelpConfigService.

classes.name: HelpConfigServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the behavior of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the HelpConfigService instance and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testGetHelpProcessorClass
methods.description: Tests that getHelpProcessorClass() returns the expected processor class name.

methods.name: testGetBaseHelpUrl
methods.description: Tests that getBaseHelpUrl() returns the expected URL.
